import os
import tempfile
import pytest

# Import the public API that is available in the codebase
from doorstop.core import Document, Item, Tree, importer, exporter
from doorstop.core.item import UID
from doorstop.core.types import Level


@pytest.fixture
def temp_dir(tmp_path):
    """Create a temporary directory for the test."""
    return tmp_path


def test_U01_2__Finite_State__TC_001(temp_dir):
    """
    Test Case for Unique Identifiers Support
    """
    # Create a new document in the temporary directory
    doc_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "doc.md")
    # The Document.new method expects a path; it will create the file if it doesn't exist
    document = Document.new(doc_path)

    # Create a new item with a unique identifier
    # The Item.new signature is: Item.new(path, uid, text, level=Level("A"))
    # We use a simple UID and text
    uid = UID("REQ-001")
    item = Item.new(os.path.join(temp_dir, f"{uid}.md"), uid, "Test requirement", level=Level("A"))

    # Add the item to the document
    document.add_item(item)

    # Reload the document to ensure persistence
    reloaded_doc = Document.load(doc_path)

    # Find the item by UID
    found_item = reloaded_doc.find_item(uid)

    # Assert that the UID is stored and can be retrieved
    assert found_item is not None, "Item should be found in the document"
    assert found_item.uid == uid, "Stored UID should match the original UID"
    assert found_item.text == "Test requirement", "Text should be stored correctly"
